name: perrinn_fw_bench_p12
notes: Core-count benchmark: the PERRINN baseline (4 elements, SA, layered half wing, 85.6 mm) on 12 processors, a fixed 300 iterations so the solve time per iteration can be compared. Timing only: use perrinn_fw_sa_half for forces. snappyHexMesh builds a slightly different mesh for each decomposition, so the cell counts differ a little.
